title.en: MALACAÑANG BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES THE REORGANIZATION OF ADMINISTRATIVE REGION VI TO INCLUDE THE PROVINCE OF PALAWAN AND PUERTO PRINCESA CITY
title.orig: MALACAÑANG BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES THE REORGANIZATION OF ADMINISTRATIVE REGION VI TO INCLUDE THE PROVINCE OF PALAWAN AND PUERTO PRINCESA CITY

text.en:
Region VI is hereby reorganized to include the Province of
Palawan and Puerto Princesa City;

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately following the
completion of its publication in a newspaper of general circulation
Done in the City of Manila, this 23 day of May in the year of our Lord,
Two Thousand and Five.
By the President:
EDUARDO R. ERMITA
Executive Secretary
CERTIFIED COPY:
LAMBERTOR: BARBIN
